target_customer: Machine learning engineers and data teams who label images for computer vision
problem: Labeling visual data for AI was done in disconnected tools with no standard way to manage and share datasets.
business_model: Open source labeling platform with a planned dataset marketplace and hosted offering
product_category: Computer vision data labeling and dataset management

founders.name: Geoffrey Vancassel
previous_startups: Sterblue (drone software for inspecting energy infrastructure)
founders.background_notes: From the YC page. The YC page calls LabelFlow the current name of his earlier company Sterblue.

founders.name: Nicolas Draber
founders.background_notes: Aerospace engineer per the YC page.

founders.name: Vincent Lecrubier
education: PhD in computer science (school not stated)
founders.background_notes: Described on the YC page as an Olympic finalist with an aerospace engineering background.

technical_complexity.rationale: A web labeling tool with dataset versioning is standard engineering with some hard parts around large image handling and collaboration.

defensibility.rationale: The tool went open source in 2021, which weakened lock-in, and many labeling tools already existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquirer found; the open source repository shows a last push around February 2023.

market_need_then: Computer vision teams needed labeled data and the YC pitch was GitHub for visual data, but no demand figures were found.

identity.logo: A 512 by 512 icon referenced in the GitHub README; no written design description found
identity.voice_and_tone: Developer focused tagline The open platform for image labeling

branding.brand_signature: The open platform for image labeling tagline

rebrands.why: The YC page shows LabelFlow as the current name of the earlier Sterblue company; Sterblue announced the LabelFlow launch in September 2021. The reason is not sourced.

branding.community_and_virality: An open source GitHub repository and public GitBook docs; no stars or community figures were opened.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive name shared by several tools in a crowded category, with limited press found.

pivots.to: LabelFlow open platform for image labeling
pivots.why: Not stated; the documentation says the team first built an open source labeling platform then moved toward dataset management

outcome_analysis: LabelFlow is the later name for the Sterblue team that joined YC in summer 2018, and CB Insights records a July 2019 seed with European investors totaling about 2.12M over six rounds. The team open sourced the labeling tool in 2021 and the repository went quiet by early 2023. The YC directory marks it inactive and a French registry entry for Sterblue shows ceased, but no announcement states a cause.
notes: No company website listed, so the fetch was impossible; the fev.vc announcement page returned 404 on fetch and was seen only in search results. CB Insights total 2.12M over 6 rounds is not decomposed, so most rounds are missing; the 2019-07 seed rests on one database. BounceWatch lists one 2018-08 round of unknown amount, and VCBacked lists a 3.3M seed from May 2023 under the name Labflow that could not be matched, so it was excluded. Sources disagree on founding year (2016 versus 2018). The ceased status is for the legal entity Sterblue and may not reflect the product. The competitor search returned only 2021 or later comparison pages, so the list is empty.
